title: Driver Appeals Desk Rulebook: Appeals, Course Reactivation and Closing of Deactivated Wayfare Agreements
content:
These rules govern how a deactivated **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** agreement returns to active or closes. The appeal window, appealable reasons, appeal limits, decision period, course settings and closing period are in the level schedule for appeals and reactivation.

## Rule 1: Appeals

A deactivation for a reason on the appealable list may be appealed by the driver, at most the level's number of appeals per deactivation; the appeal is the driver's own claim, is registered as an appeal for review and is decided by Wayfare within the decision period.

## Rule 2: The appeal window

An appeal is accepted only within the appeal window. The appeal window is counted in calendar days from the deactivation date: day 1 is the calendar day after deactivation, and the appeal must be registered no later than the last day of the window. The last day of the window is itself within it.

## Rule 3: Reactivation on appeal

An agreement is reactivated on appeal only when the appeal for that deactivation is recorded as granted; support never grants an appeal itself. The appeal's recorded outcome, tied to that agreement, is the evidence.

## Rule 4: The quality improvement course

A rating-below-minimum deactivation is reversed when the driver completes the quality improvement course after the deactivation date, at most the level's number of course reactivations in 365 days, counted as the course completions on the agreement within the 365 calendar days ending on the current day, inclusive, that were followed by a reactivation. The course is completed only on a deactivated agreement.

## Rule 5: Document lapse and closing

A document-lapse deactivation is reversed under the document compliance standard. A deactivated agreement not reactivated within the closing period of its deactivation date closes.

## Appeal window boundary (hypothetical, a 10-day window)

| Deactivation date | Day 1 | Last day of the window | Appeal registered on 2026-06-11 | Appeal registered on 2026-06-12 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-06-01 | 2026-06-02 | 2026-06-11 | accepted | not accepted |

## Route back by deactivation reason

| Deactivation reason | Way back to active |
|---|---|
| on the appealable list | an appeal recorded as granted |
| rating below minimum | completing the quality improvement course after the deactivation date |
| document lapse | under the document compliance standard |
